name: Main Process
description: Electron main process entry. Creates BrowserWindow with frameless titlebar, registers IPC handlers for filesystem CRUD, file watching via chokidar, terminal PTY management via node-pty, window controls, workspace persistence, and renderer zoom (Ctrl+=/-/0) using before-input-event. Resolves CLI workspace path, initializes IDE server, and manages per-window workspace paths with path-security validation.

dependencies.usage: Starts/stops IdeServer HTTP+WebSocket server when a workspace is set; delegates editor state updates to ideServer.updateEditorState()

functions.name: resolveCliWorkspace
functions.description: Parses CLI argv for a directory argument, resolving to absolute path

functions.name: isPathSafe
functions.description: Validates that targetPath is within the current workspace boundary

functions.name: filterEnv
functions.description: Returns a safe subset of environment variables for PTY processes

functions.name: createWindow
functions.description: Builds the main BrowserWindow with preload, zoom controls, and event wiring

functions.name: createNewWindow
functions.description: Opens a secondary window sharing workspace and terminal state

functions.name: installZoomControls
functions.description: Attaches before-input-event handler for Ctrl+=/-/0 zoom across the entire renderer
